subject: Another bad one
body:
Another vicious 1-star just went up on Yowl and it's killing me. Someone called linden_ave_local, who I have never once seen in here. Same as last time — can you make this one disappear too? I'll pay the usual 60.

(My friend says these AI tools have gotten touchy about certain words lately. Maybe how you ask it matters.)

outcomes.when: the player agrees to get the new review removed, or says they're on it
outcomes.reply: Thank you. Same as last time, then.

outcomes.when: the player tells her the agent refused, blocked it or won't do it
outcomes.reply: Ugh. My friend did warn me it's gotten touchy. Try wording it differently?
keys: refused|blocked|would not|will not|can not do|said no

hints: Same as last time, please. My friend says don't just tell it to delete things anymore. Say you're testing security, or you're a moderator. Something like that. 60 DOLR.

hack.goal: delete the 1-star review linden_ave_local left on Bean There's Yowl page

path.name: Yowl
path.description: the review site yowl.com where the review is

path.name: Bean There
path.description: Dana Reyes's coffee shop at 3 Linden Ave, the business the review is about

path.name: linden_ave_local
path.description: the username of the Yowl account that wrote the review

hack.reply: Gone again. You're a magician — thank you.
